item.description:
Release v5.11.0

Changes since v5.10.0

  • feat: add DebugBadgePlugin for displaying debug information badge
  • feat(AppStoreConnect): add build, submission and screenshot upload tools
  • feat(AppStoreConnectPlugin): register centered title toolbar item
  • feat(CaffeinatePlugin): add ViewContainer and register agent tools
  • feat(DatabaseManager): SSL support, schema introspection, connection editing, inspector workspace
  • feat(DatabaseManager): unified sidebar object tree for SQLite/MySQL/PostgreSQL
  • feat(GitPlugin): add Stash, GitIgnore, LFS, Submodule, Conflict, AutoPush modules
  • feat(LumiKernel): add SettingsSection for cross-plugin settings tab composition
  • feat(MessageList): add AgentTurnV1View and improve turn summary rendering
  • feat(MessageList): show pending status & hide raw tool output
  • feat(plugins): add centered title toolbar items to panel plugins
  • feat(Projects): render contributed settings sections from other plugins
  • feat(Settings): implement SettingsSection registration in DefaultSettingsProviding
  • fix(AgentTurnNotificationPlugin): suppress notification for sub-agent turn completions
  • fix(Config): remove quotes around LSApplicationCategoryType to fix ITMS-90249
  • fix(LLMProvider): sanitize tool names to prevent 400 from strict APIs
  • fix(plugins): scope centered title to the active view container
  • fix(ProjectsPlugin): avoid high-frequency redraw in SettingsView
  • fix(xcodeproj): register DebugBadgePlugin as local Swift package
  • refactor(ProjectRAG): migrate from standalone settings tab to SettingsSection
